Whole-person care

Recovery is rarely one-dimensional.

Our multidisciplinary team looks beyond a single symptom. We bring movement, daily living, communication, emotional wellbeing and essential healthcare together around the person and their family.

“The aim is not only to treat an impairment, but to help each person return to the life that matters to them.”

Physical therapy

Dr. Sidra Iqbal

Clinical Incharge & Physiotherapist
Head of Department – Physiotherapy, Helping Hand for Relief and Development · 5+ years of experience

Dr. Sidra is serving as Head of Department – Physiotherapy at the Comprehensive Rehabilitation Center, Bahawalpur since January 2022. She provides care for musculoskeletal disorders — including sprains, strains, fractures and overuse injuries — neurological conditions such as stroke, multiple sclerosis and Parkinson’s, paediatric rehabilitation, geriatric rehabilitation, sports-related injuries, post-surgical rehabilitation including total knee and hip replacement and spinal surgeries, and pain management. Her practice uses manual therapy, therapeutic exercise prescription, dry needling, kinesio tapping, cupping therapy, gait training and balance training.

MS Physical Therapy (MS-PT) · Riphah International University, Islamabad (2023)DPT · University of Sargodha (2020)PPTA · PakistanAHPC (Allied Health Professionals Council) · Pakistan

Certifications: Dry Needling · Manual Mobilization · Paediatrics Neurological Rehabilitation · Advanced Life Support (ALS) · Basic Life Support (BLS)

Languages: English · Urdu

Physical therapy

Dr. Rimsha Malik

Physiotherapist
Physiotherapist, Helping Hand for Relief and Development · Since March 2022

Dr. Rimsha is serving as Physiotherapist at Helping Hand for Relief and Development, Bahawalpur since March 2022. She helps patients reduce pain and improve mobility through exercises, stretching, hands-on therapy and therapeutic equipment, regularly evaluating their progress and adjusting treatment plans to support recovery. She previously completed internships as a Physiotherapist at Bahawal Victoria Hospital, Bahawalpur (Dec 2020 – Jun 2021), Civil Hospital, Bahawalpur (Sep – Nov 2020) and The Physio, Multan (Jun – Jul 2019).

DPT · Sargodha Medical College (2020)

Skills: Hands-on Therapy · Communication · Time Management · Leadership · Team Management

Certifications & training: Advanced Techniques in Comprehensive Physical Rehabilitation · Capacity Development Plan (Helping Hand) · Leadership and Personality Development Workshop (Helping Hand) · 1st International Conference “Future Med” (2018) · 2nd International Conference on Research in Special Education

Speech & language therapy

Hamna Irshad

Speech Therapist
Helping Hand for Relief and Development · 5 years of experience

Hamna assesses and treats speech, language, communication and swallowing disorders, building individualised education plans (IEPs) around each child. She is serving as Speech Therapist at Helping Hand for Relief and Development since 2021, and previously worked as a Speech Therapist and Behavior Therapist at Noor Zainab Rehabilitation Center, Lahore. Her practice includes children’s behaviour support and specialist work with autism, ADHD, intellectual disability, learning disability, cerebral palsy and hearing impairment.

Occupational therapy

Dr. Maria Yaseen

Occupational Therapist
Occupational Therapist, Helping Hand for Relief and Development · Since November 2025

Dr. Maria is serving as Occupational Therapist at Helping Hand for Relief and Development, Bahawalpur since November 2025. She carries out patient assessments and builds individualised treatment plans that support independence in daily living activities, designing therapy programmes for both children and adults and guiding patients and caregivers on home-based care. She previously completed an Occupational Therapy internship at Helping Hand for Relief and Development (Aug 2024 – Aug 2025), and earlier worked as a Physiotherapist at Iftikhar Hospital, Bahawalpur (Jul 2023 – Nov 2023) and REHAB Physiotherapy & Health Care Clinic, Bahawalpur (Dec 2022 – May 2023), with internships at Bahawalpur Victoria Hospital and Agile Rehabilitation Complex (Mar 2022 – Aug 2022).
